families.label: Flood Risk
families.description: Research-gated assessment of flood pressure from seasonal moisture backdrop, short-term trigger charts, and locality-sensitive water testimony.
families.summary: Separates flood pressure from generic rain by preserving heavy-precipitation, excess-water, and flash-flood style signatures.

families.label: Hurricane Pressure
families.description: Research-gated assessment of tropical-storm and hurricane pressure from storm-track, wind, and moisture testimonies.
families.summary: Keeps tropical storm sequences distinct from flood or generalized rain output.

families.label: Severe Convective Pressure
families.description: Research-gated assessment of thunderstorm, hail, and tornado pressure from convective and abrupt-change testimonies.
families.summary: Groups thunderstorms, hail, and tornadoes together as a first severe-convection family instead of over-splitting thin evidence.

families.label: Wind Event Pressure
families.description: Research-gated assessment of strong-wind and front-driven event pressure, including regional wind regimes.
families.summary: Preserves Mercury/front/wind logic as its own family instead of collapsing it into generic storm output.
